fields.label: Platform
fields.description: Exactly one record per platform — matches the mobile app's AppPlatform type (types/appVersion.ts) and the ?platform= query param on get_version_config.

fields.label: Active
fields.description: Unchecking this makes the mobile app ignore this record entirely (treated as version-check passed) — a kill switch for the whole version-check system without needing a new app release.

fields.label: Latest Version
fields.description: e.g. 1.0.5 — used only to offer an optional/soft update, never blocks the app.

fields.label: Latest Build
fields.description: Optional tie-breaker build number for latest_version (e.g. 1.0.5+15).

fields.label: Minimum Supported Version
fields.description: e.g. 1.0.4 — the enforcement value. Any installed version below this is blocked entirely (mandatory update).

fields.label: Minimum Supported Build
fields.description: Optional tie-breaker build number for minimum_supported_version.

fields.label: Force Update
fields.description: When checked, EVERY installed version is blocked regardless of the version comparison result — for urgent security issues or planned full outages. Separate control from Maintenance Mode below.

fields.label: iOS Store URL
fields.description: Real App Store link only — leave empty until the app is actually published. Never a placeholder/invented URL.

fields.label: Android Store URL
fields.description: Real Google Play link only — leave empty until the app is actually published.

fields.label: Arabic Update Message
fields.default: لازم تحدّث التطبيق علشان تقدر تكمل

fields.label: English Update Message
fields.default: You must update the app to continue

fields.label: Maintenance Mode
fields.description: Separate from Force Update — this blocks the app for a temporary, expected reason (scheduled maintenance), not because the installed version is unsupported.

fields.label: Maintenance Message (Arabic)
fields.default: سوق مصر تحت الصيانة حاليًا — هنرجع قريب.

fields.label: Maintenance Message (English)
fields.default: Souq Masr is under maintenance — we will be back soon.
